title: Performance harness fingerprint assumed the current 2.1 scenario authority for a 2.0 campaign

source_observation.environment: Exact immutable 2.5.5 archive on trusted Factorio 2.0.77 after successful package-source and official-data-lock preflight
source_observation.fact: The 2.0 campaign correctly declares validation/scenarios/local-2.0.json, but Get-MIRPerformanceHarnessFingerprint always required validation/scenarios/local-2.1.json. The historical worktree intentionally contains only the target-era scenario authority, so proof stopped before Factorio launch.

reproducer.expected: The harness fingerprint includes the repository-relative manual-scenario authority declared by the governed campaign and rejects unsafe or missing authority paths.
reproducer.observed: The runner failed with 'Performance harness authority is absent: validation/scenarios/local-2.1.json'.

admission.reason: The failure is solely in the package-excluded harness fingerprint. The correction makes the declared target-era authority explicit and cannot modify package bytes.

closure.evidence: The harness receives and validates the campaign-declared target-era scenario authority; exact 2.0 and 2.1 performance proofs plus hosted exact-head proof remain required.
